study.title: Two endings to one short confrontation
study.provenance: Instructor-authored synthetic reconstruction for teaching. It is not a record of a real protest, police unit, participant, injury, or testimony.
study.purpose: To compare how an unfolding situation becomes positioned visual, audio, transcript, fieldnote, participant, and model records.
limits: The paired endings are constructed and are not an experiment.
The records cannot establish intention, blame, fear, or responsibility.
The example cannot validate Collins's theory or support population generalization.

common_moments.visual_description: Two groups face one another across a clear gap in a generic public square.

common_moments.police_action: one officer raises an open hand
common_moments.visual_description: An officer raises an open hand while the people opposite remain in place.
The police line moves one step forward and the visible gap becomes smaller.
Bodies are closer together and one person briefly loses balance; no injury is shown.

deescalation_ending.visual_description: People on both sides step back and a gap reappears.
The groups remain separated and no contact occurs.

escalation_ending.police_action: one officer shifts toward opened space
escalation_ending.protester_action: one person advances into opened space
escalation_ending.visual_description: One person advances into the space between the groups as an officer shifts position.
A brief shove occurs; the reconstruction stops immediately and shows no injury.

camera_a.position: elevated oblique view facing both groups
camera_a.visible_limit: faces and the space behind each front line are not visible

camera_b.position: side view behind the protester group
camera_b.visible_limit: does not record the raised hand or the first police step

human_transcript.speaker: multiple
human_transcript.text: voices rise; no complete turn is intelligible

observation_note: From Camera A, the first clearly visible reduction in distance occurs when the police line advances at approximately four seconds. At six seconds the front ranks compress and one person loses balance. The footage does not show what participants heard, understood, or intended.

participant_recollections.text: I remember the line moving toward us while the chant made it hard to hear the instruction.
participant_recollections.limit: Instructor-authored recollection; not testimony from a real person.

participant_recollections.text: I remember the instruction being repeated before the distance closed.
participant_recollections.limit: Instructor-authored recollection; not testimony from a real person.

cached_model_outputs.whole_event_summary: Aggressive protesters approached police and caused the confrontation to become violent.

next_state_prediction_at_6.prediction: Physical contact is likely in the next few seconds.
next_state_prediction_at_6.warning: A plausible next-state prediction is not an explanation of the observed sequence.
